statement: Community subcommand 0x02 response payload has firmware bytes 0-1, controller type byte 2 (0x03 Pro), an unknown byte 3, a six-byte Bluetooth MAC at 4-9, a mostly constant byte 10 and a byte 11 indicating whether SPI-provided colours should be used. OpenPuck generates a compatible reply, with its own fixed firmware and synthetic identity.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: bluetooth_hid_subcommands_notes.md 53-64; spi_flash_notes.md 94-97; OpenPuck mode_switch_pro.cpp 756-767. Neither any retail MAC nor firmware byte string is copied.
